# IPot
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/maker/IPot.sol)

**Title:**
IPot

Minimal interface for the MakerDAO Pot (DSR savings) contract


## Functions
### dsr

Returns the Dai Savings Rate per second, as a ray (1e27)


```solidity
function dsr() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The DSR per-second rate|


### chi

Returns the rate accumulator, as a ray (1e27)


```solidity
function chi() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The current accumulated rate|


### rho

Returns the timestamp of the last drip (chi update)


```solidity
function rho() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The last drip timestamp|
